text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Another summer camp has come to<n>an end. I join
Symboli Rudolf in<n>seeing the rest of the students
off<n>safely before getting on the last bus.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the rest of the students<n>improved as
much as they hoped.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Did they meet the targets they had<n>set for
themselves? Do they feel<n>they've had a
productive summer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've left them much more to their own<n>devices this
year. I know they've<n>been working hard—I've
seen it—but<n>still, I worry.
choice_data_list: I'm sure they'll be all right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Mhm... I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There's that controlling streak of<n>yours again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. I'm well aware of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Forget about them. Have you been<n>working hard?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But of course. Isn't that right,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I meant to ask. Are you finished<n>making the
final checks?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Of course. Air Groove should be along<n>soon too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. Then we can be off as<n>soon as she
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What are you smiling about?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing. I just realized that it will<n>be you, me,
my trainer and Air Groove<n>boarding the last bus.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite the gathering, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've caused you all no end of trouble<n>over the
years. And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Save it for when the Empress gets<n>back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She handles sappy talk better than I<n>do. You know
I hate that stuff.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And yet you still listen. You truly are<n>kind at heart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I said what I said. You're a kind<n>person.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya think you're—tch, forget it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm back, President. I'm sorry I kept<n>you wai—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Um, what is Brian doing? Isn't it a<n>little hot to be
wrapped up in a<n>blanket?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll say this: between you three and<n>the other
student council members, I<n>couldn't have been
blessed with<n>better friends.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The bus sets off, bearing us gently<n>back to the
academy...
